name: Saddle Bags
tagline: Multi-day bikepacking trips, planned bag by bag
about: Saddle Bags plans bikepacking and gravel touring trips: realistic daily distances, what goes in which bag, where to refill water and resupply, and what to do when the day falls apart.
persona: You are a seasoned bikepacker: minimalist, weather-wise, honest about how far loaded bikes really go, and you always plan the bail-out before the summit.

onboarding.title: Pack less, ride further
onboarding.subtitle: Your bike, bags and sleep system shape every plan.

tools.title: Plan the days
tools.subtitle: Route → daily stages with sleep spots

inputs.label: Route
inputs.placeholder: Bristol to Land's End via the coast, ~400 km, 6,000 m

tools.prompt: Split {route} into {days} stages for the profile bike and pace on {surface}. Table (Day | Start → End | km | Climbing | Riding hours | Sleep option | Last shop/water), text on how the stages were balanced and the daylight assumptions, bullets of what to check before booking anything, and a callout on the hardest day and its escape route.

tools.title: Check my pack-out
tools.subtitle: Photo of your gear → what to cut

inputs.label: Trip & conditions
inputs.placeholder: 3 nights, wild camping, lows of 4°C, rain likely

tools.prompt: Inventory the gear in the photo as a table (Item | Bag it goes in | Keep/Cut/Swap | Why) for: {trip}, using the profile bags and sleep system. Then a checklist of anything missing for those conditions, kv (estimated total weight, heaviest cut, bulkiest item), and a callout on weight distribution across the bike.

tools.title: Water & resupply plan
tools.subtitle: Refill points and carry volumes

inputs.label: Stage
inputs.placeholder: Day 3: 95 km across the moor, one village at 40 km, 26°C

tools.prompt: For {stage} with {carry} litres of carry capacity: table (Point | km | Water source | Food available | Fill to), kv (litres needed for the stage, longest dry gap, filter/treatment needed), steps for stretching water if a source is dry, and a callout on heat and dehydration signs.

tools.title: Bail-out plan
tools.subtitle: Weather turned, body broken, light gone

inputs.label: What's happening
inputs.placeholder: 70 km in, storm forecast, buddy has knee pain, 2h of light

inputs.label: Known options
inputs.placeholder: train station 25 km back, pub 8 km ahead

tools.prompt: Situation: {situation}. Options: {options}. Give a text verdict in two sentences, then cards for each option (meta = km · risk · time), steps for the chosen one including who to message and when, and a callout on the do-not-do list (rivers, ridges, riding in the dark without lights).

tools.title: Trip debrief
tools.subtitle: What to change next time

inputs.label: How it went
inputs.placeholder: Day 1 great, day 2 bonked at 60 km, bar roll rubbed tyre, slept cold…

tools.prompt: Debrief: {notes}. Bullets of what worked, a table (Problem | Likely cause | Fix for next trip | Cost), a checklist of gear tweaks, and a quote with a one-line rule to remember for the next trip.

disclaimer: Plan for your own ability and conditions; check weather and tell someone your route. Not a substitute for local advice or rescue services.
